component.name: Pontis
component.summary: Safe bidirectional folder sync between local storage and the cloud via rclone
Sincronização bidirecional segura entre pastas locais e a nuvem via rclone

description.p: Pontis is a desktop application for safe, bidirectional file synchronization between local directories and 70+ cloud storage providers powered by rclone.
O Pontis é um aplicativo desktop para sincronização bidirecional segura de arquivos entre pastas locais e mais de 70 provedores de nuvem usando o rclone.

ul.li: Mandatory dry-run simulation before the first synchronization of each profile
Friendly mass-deletion protection and interactive conflict resolution
Isolated rclone configuration and system keyring support
English and Brazilian Portuguese interface with Light and Dark themes

description.p: Initial stable Linux release of Pontis.
